shared_elements: repeated upright linear/rectangular motifs with internal diagonal or hatch-like marks
justification: The most specific visual overlap is the presence of repeated vertical, hatch-filled marks on A’s wall and comparable repeated linear/geometric incisions among the carvings in B, with a looser shared interest in horned animal forms. The biggest difference is that A is a sparse, modern-looking interior display with a real skull and painted marks, while B is a densely carved stone surface organized in registers with many figural reliefs.
